correctness.rationale: The source theorem and its complete proof were reconstructed. The proof bounds the deleted contribution by C||f||^2 and then uses ||f||^2 <= ||K^dagger||^2||K*f||^2, producing the coefficient A-C||K^dagger||^2. The finite-dimensional example satisfies every stated structural hypothesis, including m>1 and a proper deleted subset, satisfies the printed threshold, and leaves only zero operators after deletion.

value.rationale: Deletion robustness is one of the main structural questions in frame theory, and Theorem 2.5 is a quantitative woven-erasure statement. The printed threshold can certify complete loss of the lower frame bound even in one dimension. The repair is exact for the published proof, restores the correct pseudoinverse scaling, and gives an immediately usable corrected lower bound.
